item.title: PORTER WALMART KEEPING PRECINCT 4 CONSTABLES BUSY
item.description: Update from the Porter Walmart, which we apparently weren’t leaving anytime soon. While PCT4 was still on scene and hadn’t even made it out of the parking lot, a husband and wife decided to try their luck at shoplifting. It didn’t work out. Husband in custody for felony theft. Wife in custody for misdemeanor theft.
